rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for confusing or disorienting someone.

example.jyutping: gam3 do1 go3 syun2 zaak6 gaau2 mung2 ngo5 laa3

rows.traditional: 搞到 A 一頭霧水
rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A jat1 tau4 mou6 seoi2
rows.note: Use this when different information or choices leave A baffled and unable to make sense of them.

example.english: The information can bewilder me completely.
example.traditional: 啲資料搞到我一頭霧水。
example.jyutping: di1 zi1 liu6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 jat1 tau4 mou6 seoi2
